subject: Render DELTA5 milestone: inert pass + exact depth/stencil subset PASS ASan
body:
DELTA5 implementation/host evidence is ready for review.

CONTRACT:
- nord2_render_pass returns a real inert TeguRenderEncoder on every refusal for a valid encoding descriptor: command invalid, endEncoding clears encoding, commit status5, selectors no-op. Bounded first-16 TEGU_PASS_REFUSED line=N reason=....
- Refused: sampleCount>1, resolveTexture, >2/mismatched/invalid color targets, nonzero renderTargetArrayLength, visibilityResultBuffer.
- JM PSOs may name depth/stencil formats 250..255/260 and store them; no native depth/stencil execution is claimed. Non-JM keeps the old refusal.
- A depth/stencil pass is accepted only with valid sized/texture format 250..255/260, level/slice/depthPlane0, no resolve, storeAction DontCare. With no state, or state compare=Always/no-write and stencil both disabled, generic color draws proceed exactly; any depth test/write or enabled stencil face is refused per draw with TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_REFUSED rc=-14 and no changed-result job.
- Normal store depth/stencil attachments are inert/error, so the integration cases with ordinary depth/stencil attachment store1 get non-nil/Error as requested.

HOST: extended worker real-frontend fake-JM harness, built with ASan+UBSan. Both binaries PASS: all 14 RenderBox selectors + setViewport/setScissorRect on inert encoder; sample4/resolve/mismatch/depth-store/stencil-store nonnil/Error; exactly 16 PASS_REFUSED rows with expected reasons; DontCare depth+stencil no-test draw status4; enabled-stencil draw refuses (count1,status4,rc=-14); depthFormat252/stencilFormat253 PSO succeeds. Prior delta4 tests remain green.

Files: render_encoder.inc, render_pipeline.inc, ws_selector_compat.inc, nord2_render_pass.inc, worker host_test_vs_texture.py. Hashes/STATUS being finalized. No native/phone/publish/commit. Current-tree ARM64 -Werror check only trips compute-owned compute_frontend.m:107 sign-compare (I used -Wno-error=sign-compare); frontend_jm_test.py is currently blocked by compute host-init symbols, not render. Please align integration_tests expectations with the DontCare depth/stencil subset above.
